retrieved.text: Minimum course attendance across lectures, tutorials and labs: 75%. Grade for shortage of course attendance: DB. Attendance credit for each scheduled class regardless of its length: One unit.

Attendance needed by debarred students for remedial classes: At least 50% attendance. Length of a supplementary exam compared with the regular end term: Same duration as the end-term exam. Treatment of internal marks in a supplementary exam: Existing internal marks are retained.

Maximum exceptional attendance relaxation: Up to 10%. Continuous certified illness duration considered for attendance relaxation: Two weeks. Approval to represent the university for attendance relaxation: Prior approval of the Dean.

End-of-semester and make-up theory papers can be submitted for re-evaluation. This service excludes supplementary exams and summer-term courses. Midterms, practicals, labs, assignments, projects, internships and viva assessments also fall outside the re-evaluation scope.
Who notifies approved mid-term make-up cases: Dean Academic. Initial result for an approved missed end-semester exam: I grade. Mandatory assessment for any project-course grade: Final viva.
